[Featured Project]

Recent Renovation: Mississauga Full Home Remodel

Mississauga Full Home Remodel - Bosco Cabinetry

This stunning Toronto home renovation showcases 2,100+ sq ft of expertly crafted custom kitchen cabinets and built-in storage solutions. Our team delivered a complete kitchen remodel featuring premium quartz countertops, custom cabinetry with undermount lighting, and a show-stopping double waterfall island that serves as the centerpiece of this modern family home.

This full home renovation included custom built-in closets for every bedroom, creating seamless storage solutions that maximize space and functionality. Our custom millwork extends throughout the main living areas, including a bespoke feature wall with integrated electric fireplace and entertainment center, complemented by natural red oak hardwood flooring throughout.

From the versatile basement apartment kitchen renovation to sophisticated bathroom vanities and built-in storage throughout multiple levels, this project demonstrates our expertise in residential cabinetry and custom home renovations. Every detail reflects Bosco Cabinetry's commitment to quality craftsmanship and functional design that transforms houses into dream homes.
